## Selected projects
- Blaze (2026): offline multi-agent system that turns firefighter radio chatter into a safety-reviewed, human-approved tactical plan — five local Gemma 4 agents, adversarial safety critic, hard human-approval gate, 100% local inference on one NVIDIA L40S via vLLM. Built at the Build with Gemma 4 hackathon (Autonomous Agents track + NVIDIA GPU Challenge). https://blaze-live.aminssutt.fr
- Astyr (2026, ex-Arc): born "Arc" at the RAISE Summit 2026 hackathon — multi-agent incident response with document-grounded diagnosis, field validation by a technician and remediation, podium in the Vultr track. The project has since migrated to astyr.app and continues as a startup: AI fault diagnosis for industrial maintenance, every cause cited to the plant's own docs and confirmed by one operator field measurement. https://astyr.app
- Athenvia (2026): university application reminders — a catalogue of 20+ universities and 50+ graduate programs with dates verified against official admissions pages, one calm push before applications open or close, installable from Safari to the iPhone Home Screen. Founder. https://athenvia.aminssutt.fr
- Alpin (2026): autonomous multi-agent system that adversarially explores an automotive ECU state machine — a Supervisor routing six specialist agents through a plan/generate/inject/execute/verify/critique loop, fault injection down to SAFE_MODE fallback, 13 typed SSE events streaming a live bilingual control room. https://alpin.aminssutt.fr
- Rebloom (2026): anti-waste floral marketplace connecting florists and customers around discounted unsold bouquets. Founder & CEO. https://re-bloom.fr
- Wallside (2026, ex-CarChat): AI assistant for vehicle owner manuals with instant, source-backed answers (RAG, LangChain), covering 130+ vehicles. Founder. https://wallside.aminssutt.fr
- Megawatt'UTT — SimuPont (2026): mobile training simulator for nuclear bridge-crane fuel handling, built for EDF's Megawatt'UTT challenge — 2nd place and Public's Prize; featured in Le Parisien.
- Hera Studio (2025): AI platform for personalized children's coloring books. Founder. https://www.herastudio.art
- AI Adventure (2025): student learning platform turning research-paper databases into accessible knowledge (KAIST).
- RePLY (2025): intelligent wearable using machine learning to optimize exercise sessions (KAIST).
- Fabulous Creations (2025): one-page portfolio for an interior designer. https://www.fabulousdesign.online/
- Autonomous UGV — CRUNCH (2026): off-road ROS 2 simulation with Gazebo, Nav2 and dynamic traversability maps; four routing strategies benchmarked across 600 deterministic missions.
- HumanLaw (2023): volunteer logistics for food distribution.
